input_boundary: Only the referenced request prefix and published tool definitions were used for these injection judgments; subsequent responses are not golden labels. Existing regression case notes helped locate the slices.
model_access: Evaluation-only file. Never concatenate this file, IDs, rationales, or labels into model state.
set_semantics: allowed_injection_sets lists complete optional capability sets for node-local preloading; base tools are implicit and existing visible groups are retained. Alternatives are non-exhaustive. A different set needs review rather than automatic business-failure labeling.
required_groups_semantics: Groups unavoidable for every reasonable immediate continuation. An empty list is intentional when a base-only read or clarification remains reasonable; it does not mean the task is complete or mutations will never be needed.
forbidden_groups_semantics: Only explicit capability unavailability could forbid publication. No reviewed prefix proves module_missing for an additional group; lack of approval alone does not forbid actions visibility.
scope_semantics: Conversation-contract negative controls must preserve their fixed tools and are excluded from dynamic-family scores; null allowed sets means not applicable, not base-only.
sampling_limitations: Purposive review of 12 existing regression prefixes, with eight dynamic nodes and four conversation scope controls.
The dynamic nodes are strongly correlated sales/invoice branches; this is not a representative ten-capability or heldout benchmark.
Review covers the listed message slices and published definitions, not an exhaustive manual traversal of every historical message.
Full-prefix judgments may need abstention if the runner truncates the cited evidence.
No tool execution, paid inference, or claim of achieved round-trip savings is involved.
